## Context / Problem
After the code stories of epic nonblack-brigandish-guillemot land, user docs and runbooks still describe the repo-pinned trust file `.rebar/trusted_environments.yaml`, the `rebar trusted-env` command, pinned-key trust bases and log-position key eras. On main today `git grep -l trusted_environments -- docs infra AGENTS.md ':!docs/adr'` lists `docs/concurrency.md`, `docs/exit-codes.md`, `docs/llm-framework.md`, `docs/manifest-signing.md`, `docs/mcp-auth.md`, `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, `docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md`, `docs/migrations/hmac-opcert-removal.md`, `docs/release-notes.md`, `docs/cli-reference.md` and `infra/runbooks/mcp-opcert-enforcement-flip.md`. Two of those are already handled by the code stories: `docs/cli-reference.md` is regenerated from CLI help by the validity-only and removal stories, and the removal story deletes the `trusted-env` row of `docs/exit-codes.md`. `AGENTS.md` ("Certified ops" paragraph) describes the enforcement flip as setting `verify.require_environment` + `verify.opcert_enforce_since` only. Sequencing: built on the removal story's merged commit.

## Approach
Rewrite each remaining passage to ADR 0125's model: validity-only by default (signature valid under its embedded key, subject bound, result reports `signing_key` and environment); optional `verify.trusted_opcert_keys` in the verifying environment's own config with the `untrusted` verdict; `verify.require_environment` requires a trust list; signing is never gated; trust bases `envelope_key` and `trust_list` only (no `own_key`, `pinned_environment`, or pin-file key eras). Replace instructions that edit the pin file or run `rebar trusted-env` with the trust-list equivalent (env var `REBAR_VERIFY_TRUSTED_OPCERT_KEYS` in a deployment or CI job, or the user config `~/.config/rebar/config.toml`). In `infra/runbooks/mcp-opcert-enforcement-flip.md`, the preconditions name the MCP deployment's trust list (`infra/compose/docker-compose.yml` and `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`) instead of the pin file; the flip sets `require_environment`, `opcert_enforce_since` and a `trusted_opcert_keys` list in the gating environment (for this repository's CI, `.github/workflows/verify-identity.yml` runs `rebar verify-opcert`, so the list is supplied there as `REBAR_VERIFY_TRUSTED_OPCERT_KEYS` from the CI provider's protected variables rather than committed); rollback unsets them. Update the AGENTS.md "Certified ops" sentence to name `verify.trusted_opcert_keys` as part of the flip. Add a `docs/release-notes.md` entry: `rebar trusted-env` and `.rebar/trusted_environments.yaml` removed; new `verify.trusted_opcert_keys`; new verdict `untrusted`; `trust_basis` values now `envelope_key` and `trust_list`; new `signing_key` field. Before editing, re-derive the inventory with `git grep -nE 'trusted_environments|rebar trusted-env|trusted-env\`|pinned_environment|own_key|added_at_log_position' -- docs infra AGENTS.md ':!docs/adr'` and cover every prose hit. Historical ADRs (0049, 0098, 0100, 0104) are records and keep their text. The phrase "trusted-environment" naming the remote op-cert gate service (remote-cert help, the compose `opcert` service comment) describes that service, not the pin file, and stays.

## Scope
- `docs/concurrency.md`, `docs/llm-framework.md`, `docs/manifest-signing.md`, `docs/mcp-auth.md`, `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, `docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md`, `docs/migrations/hmac-opcert-removal.md`, `docs/release-notes.md`, `docs/reuse-surface.md` (check only; its verdict table and trust-basis prose were updated by the code stories)
- `infra/runbooks/mcp-opcert-enforcement-flip.md`, `AGENTS.md`
Out of scope: code, generated `docs/cli-reference.md`, ADRs, eval corpora and test fixtures that quote the old filename as data.

## Testing
Documentation-only; no new testable behavior. Docs drift and link tests run under `make verify`. Portability: Markdown only.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `git grep -nF trusted_environments -- docs infra AGENTS.md ':!docs/adr' ':!docs/release-notes.md'` prints no hits.
- [x] `git grep -nF 'rebar trusted-env' -- docs infra AGENTS.md ':!docs/adr' ':!docs/release-notes.md'` prints no hits.
- [x] `git grep -nE 'pinned_environment|own_key' -- docs ':!docs/adr' ':!docs/release-notes.md'` prints no hits.
- [x] `git grep -n trusted_opcert_keys -- infra/runbooks/mcp-opcert-enforcement-flip.md` and `git grep -n trusted_opcert_keys -- AGENTS.md` each print at least one hit.
- [x] `docs/release-notes.md` names `trusted-env`, `verify.trusted_opcert_keys`, `untrusted`, `trust_list` and `signing_key` (checked: `git grep -c -e trusted_opcert_keys -e untrusted -e trust_list -e signing_key -- docs/release-notes.md`).
- [x] `make verify` is green, and the change lands through Gerrit with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
